about: Each figure is the one the source page gave on the date read, quoted in page_text; a rule's values_mm are those figures. The page shows no date of its own. A figure marked derived is worked out from the quoted text, the working given. Read the page again before relying on a preset: a fabricator changes its figures.

jlcpcb_2layer_1oz.description: JLCPCB's minimums for a 2-layer board with 1 oz copper, standard drills (no 0.1 mm microvias), green, red, yellow, blue or purple solder mask.
